rows.name: GR-ref-compass
rows.note: the shipped SHIP template; every GR row is read against this

rows.name: VC-ref-alluvium
rows.note: the shipped SHIP template; every VC row is read against this

rows.name: GR-dilate-SPREAD-REC
rows.note: DILATION: root size from RECOVERY. Smallest under stress, largest in recovery.

rows.name: GR-dilate-SPREAD-DD
rows.note: the same drive on DRAWDOWN — the polarity check. Largest under stress.

rows.name: GR-dilate-CONTRACT-RING
rows.note: CONTRACT under RING/BRANCH, where the atlas measures it as an EXTENT control (0.88 -> 0.99).

rows.name: GR-separate-CONTRACT-QUAD
rows.note: CONTRACT under QUAD/TRI, where it is a DENSITY control: children a fifth of the parent (separate levels) up to nearly parent-size (overlapping mass).

rows.name: GR-displace-ROTATE
rows.note: DISPLACEMENT: per-level angle, at a NON-ZERO ceiling. The atlas measured this drive dead only at rotation 0, where law L2 disables it.

rows.name: GR-subtract-DEPTH
rows.note: SUBTRACTION by generation count. The atlas says the document changes 30x and the picture does not; this asks whether that holds at a browse-size dE rather than at ink.

rows.name: GR-displace-PRUNE
rows.note: PRUNE at branch 3 with a mask that is neither all-ones nor single-bit, and no BSP in the set — the three conditions law L2 and L3 say make it dead.

rows.name: GR-asymmetry
rows.note: ASYMMETRY, the sixth drive, which the atlas measures at 2 of 6 identical and never explains.

rows.name: GR-sym-none
rows.note: symSet {NONE}: the non-rosette baseline. Extent and seed diversity without any rotational replication.

rows.name: GR-sym-rot
rows.note: symSet {ROT3, ROT6}: the rosette. Twelve blind reviews named this reading in six of twelve cases.

rows.name: GR-sets-wide
rows.note: compass's own set widths — four symmetries, four productions, three shapes — on this probe's skeleton. The seed-diversity question.

rows.name: GR-sets-narrow
rows.note: one member per set. The seed reaches nothing categorical, which is the shape of the `idol` failure.
rows.detail: {"code":48,"name":"ERR_SEED_BLIND","detail":"NO SET IN THE WHOLE CONFIGURATION HAS MORE THAN ONE MEMBER, so the token's seed cannot choose anything categorical and every token is the same figure with different dials on it. Give one shapeSet, ruleSet or symSet a second member. This is the runtime refusing the exact defect an independent visual review found in it — twelve seeds indistinguishable at thumbnail size — before the binding is spent rather than after."}

rows.name: GR-linework
rows.note: stroke true: the loudest coverage control in the runtime, and what a fine-line brief needs.

rows.name: GR-two-rule
rows.note: two rules on opposed sensors — the atlas's stated minimum for three distinguishable states.

rows.name: VC-subtract-COUNT-REC
rows.note: SUBTRACTION: members are lost. countMin is a CREATOR-OWNED floor, so the low state is sparse rather than blank.

rows.name: VC-subtract-COUNT-DD
rows.note: the same drive on DRAWDOWN — the polarity check. More members under stress.

rows.name: VC-separate-SPREAD-REC
rows.note: SEPARATION: the count is pinned and only the interval moves. Floor 16 is a visible tight cluster, not a blank.

rows.name: VC-fracture-SPREAD-DD
rows.note: FRACTURE: a few large members that overlap into one mass at the spread floor and separate as it rises. DRAWDOWN, so they come apart under stress.

rows.name: VC-fracture-SPREAD-REC
rows.note: the same construction on RECOVERY: consolidates under stress, comes apart in recovery.

rows.name: VC-thicken-WEIGHT-rect
rows.note: THICKENING: WEIGHT writes stroke-width and nothing else. Measured 0.000 filled and 0.096 stroked, so the field must be stroked for the binding to exist at all.

rows.name: VC-thicken-WEIGHT-line
rows.note: the same drive on LINE, which the runtime always strokes whatever the flag says.

rows.name: VC-thicken-WEIGHT-filled
rows.note: the negative control: the identical binding on a FILLED field, where the atlas measured 6 of 6 byte-identical state pairs.

rows.name: VC-erode-SIZE-secondary
rows.note: EROSION on a SECONDARY register: field 1 shrinks to the size floor of 2 and vanishes while field 0 carries the composition alone.

rows.name: VC-dilate-SIZE-DD
rows.note: SIZE on the ONLY field, driven by DRAWDOWN — whose curved floor is 326 per mille rather than 0, so the low state is small rather than empty.

rows.name: VC-dilate-SIZE-REC
rows.note: the blank-frame control: SIZE driven by RECOVERY, which reads ZERO at stress, so every element resolves to the bytecode floor of 2.

rows.name: VC-displace-JITTER
rows.note: DISPLACEMENT: per-site perturbation. The atlas measures 0.017 ink filled, which is movement without coverage.

rows.name: VC-stack-bands
rows.note: the only layout that reads as horizontal bands, with COUNT driven: beds lost and returned.

rows.name: VC-extent-1field
rows.note: ONE field at the spread ceiling. The 'centred island with dead margin on all four sides' question, asked directly.

rows.name: VC-extent-3field
rows.note: THREE fields all at the spread ceiling. Each draws its own seed byte, so the reach of the whole is the maximum of three draws rather than one.

rows.name: VC-extent-3field-tapered
rows.note: the same three fields with the secondaries held INSIDE the primary, which is what the round-1 author did.

rows.name: VC-ground-linear-dark
rows.note: a graded ground between TWO DARK stops — what alluvium ships. The atlas's 0.696 loudness figure is for a ground pair with contrast in it.
